$comment: WORK-026-2 (RUN-003) synthesized SFX placeholders, ASSET-018. Pure sine partials with exponential envelopes; no noise, samples or speech. Rendered by tools/assets/sfx-placeholders.mjs to 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit WAV, then afconvert AAC 96k (m4a) and Vorbis (ogg). Notes: start ms from sample 0; partials: freq Hz (glideTo Hz over glideMs), amp, decay per second. Lengths sit >= 60 ms under the ASSET-018 limits to absorb AAC priming/padding.

entries.class: three-note ascending warm chime (C5 E5 G5), longest tail
